name: Toast
description: Brief feedback about an action or event, shown above the page without interrupting the current task.
source: Documents the current unthemed Angular Toast used by Designer (libs/ui-toolkit/angular/src/lib/toast). Palette tokens are existing palette equivalents of the toolkit SCSS values, not extracted Figma bindings. No Figma component link has been verified.

props.name: messageType
props.description: Sets the fill and default icon. Designer's wrapper exposes success, warning, and error; Info is available through the toolkit service.

props.name: title
props.description: Short outcome in sentence case. Open Sans 14px / 22px, weight 600. Provide a title, a message, or both.

props.name: message
props.description: Optional explanation or next step, Open Sans 12px / 18px, weight 400. Wrap the full text; do not truncate.

props.name: icon
props.description: Defaults to the matching semantic icon in a 24px box. The toolkit accepts an icon override; keep its meaning consistent with the message.

props.name: className / appendTo
props.description: Toolkit escape hatches for themed runtime content and a custom overlay host. Not additional visual variants.

example.title: Stage saved
example.message: Your changes are ready to use.

variants.name: Warning
variants.useCase: Explain a recoverable condition that needs attention.

example.title: Some changes could not be applied
example.message: Review the affected fields before continuing.

variants.name: Info
variants.useCase: Share a neutral update about an operation.

example.title: Export started
example.message: You can keep working while the file is prepared.

variants.name: Error
variants.useCase: Explain a failed action and the next step.

example.title: Failed to load builds
example.message: Try again. If the problem continues, contact your administrator.

statesNote: No visual state axis. Hover and keyboard focus pause the timer but do not change appearance; the only state styling is the close button focus ring.
sizesNote: Toast has one size. Content determines width and height. There are no Small, Medium, or Large variants.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Borderless filled surface, horizontal layout, items vertically centered, 8px vertical and 16px horizontal padding, 16px gap, 8px radius, width fits content up to 1200px

anatomy.name: TypeIcon
anatomy.description: Semantic icon from the toolkit in a 24x24 box, vertically centered, does not shrink

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.description: Outcome of the action, Open Sans 14/22 SemiBold, visible when a title is provided

anatomy.name: Message
anatomy.description: Supporting explanation, Open Sans 12/18 Regular, visible when a message is provided, no extra gap between title and message lines

anatomy.name: Close
anatomy.description: Trailing 12x12 cross icon on every toast, 24px minimum target, dismisses only this toast before its timer finishes

anatomy.name: Stack
anatomy.description: Always bottom center, 36px from the bottom edge, 8px between items, newest at the bottom with older toasts above

shadow.note: Exact source shadow. It has no match in the elevation scale (xs 0 2px 8px through xl 0 24px 32px, all #1634621a).

dark.note: No dark override exists. The .dark theme does not redefine the palette tokens the toast uses, so it renders the same values on dark surfaces. A shared dark Toast treatment still needs separate review.

whiteTextContrast.note: Warning and Info fall below the 4.5:1 reference target. Source colors are documented, not certified as accessible.

behavior.placement: Always bottom center, 36px from the bottom edge. Keep the close button reachable above fixed navigation or an on-screen keyboard.
behavior.stacking: 8px between toasts, newest at the bottom, older toasts stacked above. The documentation demo caps the stack at three; that limit applies only to the demo.
behavior.pause: Hover pauses the timer and resumes the remaining time on leave; the remaining time is preserved rather than restarted. The documentation also pauses for keyboard focus inside the toast. Angular pauses only on hover.
behavior.dismissal: Close button on every toast removes only its toast before the timer finishes. Clicking the toast body does not dismiss it.
behavior.actions: Toast actions are not supported. Follow-up controls belong in the page.
behavior.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables both animations and removes the toast immediately (0ms delay).
behavior.sourceAnimation: The Angular source uses a 300ms height entry and a 200ms height/opacity exit; the documentation preview replaces these with the transform/opacity animations above.
behavior.focus: Focus stays on the triggering control when a toast appears. After dismissing a focused toast, focus returns to a meaningful control.

useCases.title: Confirm the outcome
useCases.description: Confirm a completed action when the result is not obvious in the current view. Name what changed. "Stage saved" is an existing FlowX message.

useCases.title: Explain what needs attention
useCases.description: Use a warning for a recoverable condition. Give the user enough context to act, and keep required corrections visible in the page.

useCases.title: Share a neutral update
useCases.description: Explain an event without implying success or failure. For ongoing work, keep progress in the page and use the toast only as a brief update.

useCases.title: Explain the failure and next step
useCases.description: Name the failed operation and a useful next step. Avoid exposing raw server errors. "Failed to load builds" is an existing FlowX message.

do: Provide a title, a message, or both, in sentence case.
Let long text wrap and grow vertically; width follows content up to 1200px and the available viewport width.
Keep essential instructions and recovery controls available in the page after the toast disappears.
Use an inline message when information needs to remain visible.
Keep any icon override consistent in meaning with the message.
dont: Don't truncate the title or message.
Don't put actions inside a toast; follow-up controls belong in the page.
Don't expose raw server errors in an Error toast.
Don't replace the solid Warning (Orange 500) and Info (Blue 400) fills silently; they differ from the soft status-pill palette.

accessibility.role: Guidance: status for routine feedback; alert for important, time-sensitive failures. Announce updates without moving focus.
keyboard: Tab / Shift+Tab reach the close button. Pause dismissal while focus is inside the toast.
Enter / Space activate the focused close button.
Leave focus on the triggering control when a toast appears. After dismissing a focused toast, return focus to a meaningful control.
aria: aria-atomic="true" announces the complete title and supporting message together.
aria-label gives the close control an accessible name such as "Dismiss notification".
aria-hidden="true" hides the decorative type and close icons from assistive technology.

The documentation preview wraps each live toast in role="group" with aria-label "{Type} notification", announces non-error toasts through a role="status" region and errors through a role="alert" region.
A 2 to 10 second timer alone does not establish accessibility; keep essential information and recovery controls in the page.
Angular lacks explicit live-region roles and focus pause. React announces every type as an alert.

decisionLog.decision: Always use bottom-center placement, automatic timing, and a close button; omit toast actions.
decisionLog.reasoning: Current design guidance limits Toast to brief feedback in a consistent location. Duration follows content length, the close button is always available, and any follow-up controls belong in the page.

adoptionNotes: React uses a 3-second minimum for Warning and Info, compared with Angular's 2 seconds. Its Toast does not pause on hover or focus, always schedules a timeout, marks every toast as an alert, and has no equivalent queue service.

Angular groups by the raw position value: mixing an omitted position with an explicit bottom-center value can omit messages from an existing stack. Normalize the default consistently when integrating.
Themed runtime overrides and a shared dark Toast treatment still need separate review.
gaps: No dark theme treatment is defined; colors.dark repeats the light values because no source overrides them.
No Figma component or figmaLink has been verified; all values come from the Angular toolkit code and the site's rendered preview.
The container shadow (0 10px 24px 0 rgba(15, 17, 20, 0.1)) has no match in the elevation scale and is not a shared token.
White text on the Warning (2.88:1) and Info (3.62:1) fills is below the 4.5:1 target; colors are documented, not approved.
Toast has no action slot, so no Button variant is reused; button.json does not apply.
No hover or pressed styling is defined for the close button; only a focus-visible outline exists.
The rendered Info icon uses a 16x16 viewBox scaled into the 24px box; Success, Warning, and Error use 24x24 viewBoxes.
The spec exposes messageType values in lowercase (success, warning, info, error) while variant names and the rendered data-toast-type attribute are capitalized (Success, Warning, Info, Error).
Entry and exit animations (320ms / 260ms transform and opacity) are documentation-preview values; the Angular source animates height over 300ms in and 200ms out.
No maximum number of stacked toasts is defined in the source; the three-toast cap is demo-only.
No minimum width, minimum height, or fixed height is defined; height and width follow content.
